tools.name: repricer_list_report_requests
tools.description: List report requests with their status (ReportRequestId, report type, processing status). Use it to find the ReportRequestId of a report that you requested. Repricer API: GET /reports/requests.

tools.name: repricer_list_reports
tools.description: List the generated reports that are ready to download, with their ReportId and availability date. Use a ReportId with repricer_download_report. Repricer API: GET /reports.

tools.name: repricer_download_report
tools.description: Download a generated report as CSV text by its ReportId (from repricer_list_reports). Long files are cut by the server, and the reply says so. Repricer API: GET /reports/download/{id}.

tools.name: repricer_get_repricer_file
tools.description: Export the account's repricer file as CSV: the All Available Fields Amazon template with every listing. The call has a 2-minute timeout and is not suitable above 25,000 SKUs; use a report for large accounts. Long files are cut by the server, and the reply says so. Repricer API: GET /repricers.

tools.name: repricer_submit_report_request
tools.description: Ask Repricer to generate a report (for example __INVENTORY__). It returns a ReportRequestId. Repricer starts the next report only after the previous one completes. Check progress with repricer_list_report_requests. Repricer API: POST /reports/requests.

tools.name: repricer_schedule_report
tools.description: Create or change a report schedule, so Repricer regenerates the report on that period (each new run overwrites the last report). Use schedule NEVER to remove the schedule. Schedule values: 30_MINUTES, 1_HOUR, 2_HOURS, 4_HOURS, 8_HOURS, 12_HOURS, 1_DAY, 2_DAYS, 3_DAYS, 7_DAYS, 14_DAYS, 15_DAYS, 30_DA

tools.name: repricer_upload_repricer_file
tools.description: Import a CSV file into the Repricer account. The import changes repricing settings (minimum and maximum prices, rules) of the listings in the file, and so can change live prices on the marketplace. Only the All Available Fields Amazon template is supported. A second import fails until the first one

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: repricer_submit_report_request · Private data: repricer_download_report, repricer_get_repricer_file, repricer_upload_repricer_file · Public sink: repricer_submit_report_request, repricer_schedule_report, repricer_upload_repricer_file · Destructive: repricer_schedule_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: repricer_submit_report_request · Private data: repricer_download_report, repricer_get_repricer_file, repricer_upload_repricer_file · Public sink: repricer_submit_report_request, repricer_schedule_report, repricer_upload_repricer_file · Destructive: repricer_schedule_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
